annotations.summary: Dentari Production: HTTP availability requires attention
annotations.description: {{ if $values.A }}State code: {{ $values.A.Value }} (0=DOWN, 1=DEGRADED, -1=UNKNOWN, 2=UP).{{ else }}Monitoring query returned no usable result.{{ end }} Checks run every 5 minutes from London and Frankfurt. Alert fires below 2 for 1 minute; missing probe data expires after 15 minutes.

model.expr: (sum((last_over_time(probe_success{job="dentari-prod-http",instance="https://dentari-prod-3040.apps.oec.sh/"}[15m]) and topk by (probe) (1, max_over_time(timestamp(probe_success{job="dentari-prod-http",instance="https://dentari-prod-3040.apps.oec.sh/"})[15m:30s])))) and (count((last_over_time(probe_success{job="dentari-prod-http",instance="https://dentari-prod-3040.apps.oec.sh/"}[15m]) and topk by (probe) (1, max_over_time(timestamp(probe_success{job="dentari-prod-http",instance="https://dentari-prod-3040.apps.oec.sh/"})[15m:30s])))) == 2)) or vector(-1)
